purpose: Test whether admitting only short-work nonterminal parents-scheduled players recovers the broad-pipeline QPR benefit while retaining the terminal-pipeline throughput result.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.v156_observation: The unrestricted pipeline frontier passed QPR but left only 11/20 throughput wins.
causal_diagnosis.v157_observation: The terminal-only frontier restored throughput to 1.4948 and 12/20 wins but reduced QPR below OCS.
causal_diagnosis.mechanism: A nonterminal child can still be completion-proximal when little immutable DAG work remains. Restricting this speculation by current request remaining work should keep short chains moving without reserving containers for heavy unfinished workflows.

threshold_derivation.units: dimensionless request remaining work used by the existing V155 SRPT order
threshold_derivation.definition: sum over unfinished functions of cpu/mean_node_cpu + cold_start_frames/1000 + output_mb/1000
threshold_derivation.rationale: 5.5 is the disclosed midpoint separating the light E09 chain, where broad pipeline placement produced the strongest QPR gain, from the heavier dominant E18/E20 chains. It is frozen before implementation and is not estimated from any V158 result.

single_mechanism_change_from_v157.ready_players: unchanged: admit after every parent completes
single_mechanism_change_from_v157.terminal_pipeline_players: unchanged: admit when every parent has an assigned node
single_mechanism_change_from_v157.new_short_pipeline_players: also admit a nonterminal parents-scheduled player only when current request remaining work is at most 5.5
single_mechanism_change_from_v157.rejected_pipeline_players: nonterminal parents-scheduled players with request remaining work above 5.5
unchanged: queue density threshold 8.0 and exact V155 scoring router
SRPT order and its existing remaining-work definition
NSESche solver, welfare, pricing and feasibility
common HPA, tapes, metrics and policy-independent references

allowed_inputs: immutable DAG terminal-function topology and unfinished resource descriptors
current request remaining work computed by the unchanged SRPT formula
current queue density used by the unchanged V155 router

checks: exact E09, E18 and E20 product/order with no additional seed or baseline
valid QC, ledger, archive inventory, runtime identity and offline reference pairing
every admitted nonterminal incomplete-parent player has request remaining work at most 5.5
every rejected nonterminal incomplete-parent player has request remaining work above 5.5
terminal incomplete-parent players remain admitted regardless of work
at least one short-work nonterminal player, one terminal pipeline player and one over-threshold rejection are observed
every queue route matches the unchanged V155 threshold-8 router and both routes occur
zero performance or aggregate outcome fields are parsed before audit sealing

diagnostic_selection_rule.evaluation: Replace only V155 E09, E18 and E20 with V158 and recompute the unchanged complete E01-E20 gates.
diagnostic_selection_rule.throughput_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins, including at least 2 of 3 diagnostic wins
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_mean_gate: both QPR conventions strictly greater than OCS 0.055577160345697
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins with 20 of 20 finite-only values
diagnostic_selection_rule.joint_diagnostic_pass: every listed gate passes without editing this plan
diagnostic_selection_rule.failure: retain all three valid V158 diagnostics, retire V158 and continue mechanism analysis without running the other seventeen
diagnostic_selection_rule.success: authorize a separately committed remaining-seventeen V158 training plan reusing these three rows
